title: Taiwanese Graduate Student Association at UC Irvine
content_html:
The Taiwanese Graduate Student Association (TGSA) at UC Irvine is a graduate student organization serving Taiwanese graduate students at the university. Known in Chinese as UCI台灣研究生學生會, TGSA operates a Google Sites page and a Facebook Group (facebook.com/groups/ucitgsa), both of which have minimal current public-facing content.

A GitHub organization profile (github.com/uci-tgsa) is associated with TGSA, with its last repository update recorded in June 2019, and links to an older club URL (clubs.uci.edu/tgsa) that no longer resolves. The Google Sites page is labeled as an older version (舊版), suggesting the organization may have migrated platforms or reduced its web presence over time.

No founding year, formal mission statement, or current event listings are available from first-party sources at the time of research.
